newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton steady in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: India cotton steady in sluggish trade.

text.p: Cotton prices were little changed on Thursday in sluggish trade, dealers said.
Heavy rains in producing centres and the lack of fresh export quota announcement by the government kept prices steady, they said.
In spot deals, Bengal-deshi was steady at 945/1,000 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and Punjab saw-ginned at 1,800/1,840 rupees per maund.
In the Gujarat segment, Kalyan cotton was quiet at 14,000/14,300 rupees per candy (355.56 kg), Wagad cotton at 12,700 rupees and Kala-ginned at 12,000 rupees.
The market is closed on Friday for a Moslem festival.
